strengths: Explicitly dismantles “Japanese people never say no”
Situates softness in service / acquaintance / workplace contexts rather than national essence
Compares soft strategies worldwide without unique-harmony myth

issues.problem: Wrong Japanese: kannō (感応) is not the polite “I’ll consider it” phrase. The intended expression is kentō shimasu (検討します)
issues.suggestion: Replace with *kentō shimasu* (検討します) and keep the gloss “I’ll consider it”

issues.problem: Mild exoticizing cue for a common pragmatic pattern
